_note: The flows on forkable.dev/mcp. Each one is a prompt, the tools the agent calls, and the UI it writes: src/flows/<id>.tsx, a render_ui module against the blocks MCP kit (@forkable/ui). actions are the ids the UI declares to render_ui, checked in One's catalog with the One CLI on 2026-10-28. On the page they run on the Acme Inc sample (src/flows/sample/), not a real account.

flows.name: Morning command center
flows.description: Your next meetings, the unread mail from real people and what Stripe took since yesterday, on one screen.
flows.prompt: Give me one screen for this morning: my next meetings, the unread emails that need me, and what came in on Stripe since yesterday.
flows.reply: Here is your morning on one screen. It reads your calendar, Gmail and Stripe, and changes nothing.

flows.name: Meeting prep
flows.description: The next meeting with guests, the last month of mail with each of them, and an agenda built from what is still open.
flows.prompt: Prep me for my next meeting: who is in it, my last emails with each of them, and draft an agenda from anything I still owe them.
flows.reply: Your next meeting is Northwind terms, with Priya, Rosa and Victor. I pulled the last month of mail with each of them and started an agenda. Saving the draft waits for your Confirm.

flows.name: Follow-up radar
flows.description: Every email you sent that never got an answer, oldest first, with a nudge you can edit and send in one click.
flows.prompt: Which emails did I send in the last month that never got a reply? Oldest first, with a one-click nudge.
flows.reply: These are still waiting on a reply. Pick one to write a nudge. It goes out only after you confirm.

flows.name: Revenue pulse
flows.description: MRR, collected, failed payments and overdue invoices from Stripe, with a payment reminder drafted in Gmail.
flows.prompt: How is revenue this month? MRR, new and failed payments, who is overdue, and a button to draft a payment reminder.
flows.reply: Here is the last 30 days on Stripe. Reminders are saved as Gmail drafts, and each one asks you first.

flows.name: Investor update
flows.description: MRR and growth from Stripe, what shipped on GitHub, written up as a draft you edit and save to Gmail.
flows.prompt: Write my monthly investor update from Stripe revenue and what we merged on GitHub in acme/acme-app. Let me edit it, then save it as a Gmail draft.
flows.reply: I wrote the update from your numbers and what shipped. Pick what goes in, edit freely, and save it when it reads right.

flows.name: Inbox by sender
flows.description: Your inbox grouped by who sent it, newsletters split from people, and everything from a sender archived at once.
flows.prompt: Group my inbox by sender, show me which ones are just newsletters, and let me archive everything from a sender at once.

trail.result: Batch Modify a User’s Gmail Messages (Labels)

flows.reply: Here is your inbox by sender. Pick the ones you never read and archive them together. You confirm before anything moves.
